text:
Ava (People Ops): Hey everyone — quick heads up: the Infra Summit is set for Minneapolis, June 8-10. We're opening hotel blocks and travel stipends today. RSVP form + details below. :tada:

Liam (People Ops): please read — there are options for partners/family travel and childcare reimbursement.

Ravi (Infra): Awesome. Is there a recommended flight window? I'm trying to figure out heading in the night before.

Ava (People Ops): @Ravi we recommend arriving the evening of June 7 or morning of June 8. Summit sessions start 9am on the 8th. If you come the night before, the company will cover one additional night for those with >4 hour flights or redeye.

Jamie (People Ops): Quick breakdown:
- Standard travel stipend: $650 USD (covers economy flights + ground).
- Long-haul top-up: additional $250 for flights >6 hours.
- Partner/family travel credit: up to $400 if you bring a partner.
- Childcare reimbursement: up to $200/day (provide receipt).

Sofia (Security): Will we have locked bag storage at the venue? I need to know for equipment.

Liam (People Ops): Yes — secure equipment check available on-site. We'll share location and hours next week.

TravelBot: Your stipend claim for Ava's team event created. Reference: TRV-2024-1194. Submit receipts within 30 days.

Ravi (Infra): Thanks. How do I book the hotel in the company block? Link?

Ava (People Ops): Book via this page: https://travel.redwood.example/minneapolis-summit (internal link). Hotel block ends May 18. If block sold out, reach out to people-ops and we'll expand options.

Jamie (People Ops): For international teammates: we will convert stipends to local currency at fair market rate and handle visa support letters if you need one. DM me with passport name + dates.

Ravi (Infra): Is remote attendance an option for those who can't travel?

Ava (People Ops): Yes — keynotes and workshops will be streamed. We encourage in-person for the networking tracks but we'll have remote breakout rooms. Mark "remote" on the RSVP form if you're not coming on-site.

Sofia (Security): Any rules about devices on-site? We follow standard BYOD + disk encryption policy, yes?

Liam (People Ops): Correct. Please bring company laptop with full-disk encryption enabled. If you need a loaner, say so in the RSVP.

Ava (People Ops): Expense submission snippet (paste into expense form):
```
Expense: Flight
Amount: $XXX.XX USD
Date: 2026-06-07
Category: Travel - Summit
Notes: Infra Summit Minneapolis - ticket attached
```

Jamie (People Ops): FAQ highlights:
- Covid policy: optional masks; we'll have KN95s at registration.
- Accessibility: venue is ADA compliant; dietary needs handled via the RSVP form.
- Code of conduct: standard Redwood code applies.

Ravi (Infra): Great, thanks. One last q: can I get the long-haul top-up if I choose business for health reasons?

Ava (People Ops): Long-haul top-up is for coach fares only. If you need premium economy/business for medical reasons, submit a pre-approval request to people-ops@redwood.ai with justification and medical note where applicable. We'll handle case-by-case.

TravelBot: Reminder scheduled: RSVP deadline May 25.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks team — any other questions, reply here or DM People Ops. See you in Minneapolis (or on the stream)! :airplane:
